---
title: "How do I calculate an average separately for each group?"
---

## What the question asks

How do I calculate an average separately for each group?

## Steps in RStudio

1. Match each numeric value to one group label.

2. Check group sizes with table().

3. Use tapply() or aggregate() with mean().

## Runnable example

```{r}
group <- c("north","north","south","south","south")
temperature_c <- c(7,9,11,15,13)
print(table(group))
print(tapply(temperature_c,group,mean))
```

## Interpret the result

The example north mean is 8°C and south mean is 13°C. Different group sizes do not make either mean invalid, but they matter for uncertainty.

## Check before applying this to real data

Count observations in each group and decide how missing measurements affect each average.
